meaning: Five typed boundaries in the original independent-potency dictionary: the weaker relevant-respect link fails to yield the absolute conclusion even with the being-in-act reduction; it fails to transfer well-founded per-se regress to the exact VII.1 and VIII.5 chains; the relative conclusion can coexist with all other generic Stage1 inputs and no God witness; and the director-regress interface with that weak link fails even retaining its through-director and unmoved-design bridges. The director test retains excluded middle explicitly. No claim covers additional Fourth-Way, later-attribute, problem-of-evil or historical premises.
